data.name: Dilsad
data.gender_notes: Dilsad is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dilsad is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'dil' meaning 'heart' and 'hast' meaning 'joy'. This name is believed to signify the one who brings joy and happiness to the heart. In Hindu mythology, Dilsad is also the name of a Yakshi, a supernatural being believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Dilsad carries the meaning “Delight, Joy, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Dilsad usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The word 'Dil' being a deeply emotional term in Hinduism, the name resonates with the idea of inner happiness, chasing the ultimate goal of attaining an enlightened and joyful state of being!
data.spiritual_significance: Meanwhile, from a spiritual perspective, Dilsad is believed to embody the energies of love, kindness, and positivity, three powerful forces that not only enrich inner growth but also help one connect deeper with the divine. It is also another reminder that human emotions hold a powerful connection with spiritual growth and that the heart (Dil) is an essential vessel for the soulful journey. In Hindu mythology, a Yakshi like Dilsad represents monsoon rains, symbolizing prosperity and new beginnings, further emphasizing the name's spiritual significance.
